Outrageous and unacceptable experience.
Mar 2026 • Couples
We arrive at 21:15, when the kitchen is supposed to close at 22:00. From the beginning, the welcome is cold and unpleasant. The waitress only takes the drinks... then disappears completely. The result: more than 30 minutes waiting without any order to eat. No one cares about us, we are literally ignored.

We have to call the waitress ourselves to finally place the order, which was also extremely simple. And then, at the height of the incompetence: she comes back to tell us that the kitchen is closed and that we can only have soup.

This is simply unacceptable. We are wasted our time, ignored, and then denied food when we were largely on schedule.

No commercial gestures, no excuses worth the name. Worse still, the waitress tries to clear customs instead of accepting her mistake. A total lack of professionalism and respect for customers.

We paid for our drinks and left, sickened.

Absolutely fleeing.

Poor service, poor food - go somewhere else
Jul 2025 • Couples
Unfortunately this turned out to be the most unpleasant eating experience in a 10 day trip in Vietnam. Although the restaurant was almost empty an early Saturday evening (before heading to the airport), the many waitresses on duty were mostly busy on their mobilephones, not with serving their customers. 
A Thai salad came out first with almost rare beef on top, was sent back to the kitchen, and the same dish came back again 10 minutes later after the same beef was given a little extra time on the pan. This dish was not worth eating. Hence, a quick option was to order the fried rice and eggs, to keep up the pace with my companions dish. However, after waiting for the second option for 25 minutes, then being told it would take another 10 minutes to get the fried rice with eggs course done, we decided to leave.
Didn’t seem like this place really cared about their customers.
There are plenty of very good restaurants in Hà Nội, so choose another one than this.

Not a great experience
Mar 2025 • Friends
Unfortunately our trip here was a shambles from beginning to end. Needed to ask for enough seats and menus multiple times, with a lot of the food orders coming out wrong. 

Our waitress carried a scowl the whole time and was constantly playing on her phone, as were a lot of the other workers. The food was ok but are pretty small portions and don't match the pictures in the menu.

Had to ask 3 different people and wait for an uncomfortably long time to get the bill, and when it came to confirming what was on said bill, they thought we were ordering again and brought out 2 more plates of food instead. It was a mess to sort out, especially as all of the waiting and kitchen staff came out to watch the supervisor sort it out with us. The manager was nowhere to be seen.

Having said all of that, shout out to Lng - you are a superstar and the only one who actually made us feel welcome. You're doing a great job, thank you for your service.

Expensive by local standards
Dec 2024 • Couples
We slip into this restaurant without doing a minimum of “due diligence” as we usually do because we have little time and a train to catch. Being a steakhouse and wanting to avoid Vietnamese dishes tonight we take a T-bone (the specific Australian menu) of the garlic posa and 3 medium beers in two. The bill will be about 70€ which is more or less five times what you pay for eating local cuisine and drinking beer. Unfortunately, the meat did not turn out to be very good either (a little bit fatty and not very tender). In short, not a good experience so I warn sailors if you want a steak try to look elsewhere maybe you will be luckier than us.
